Package gov.Lab3

Class Company

java.lang.Object
gov.Lab3.Company
All Implemented Interfaces:
Profile, Comparable<Profile>
public class Company extends Object implements Profile
An organisational entity (company, institution, or group) in the social network.

Company is the Profile implementation for non-human nodes. Companies can be linked to Person profiles via employment or partnership relationships, and to other companies via partner relationships.

Equality and hashing are based solely on the company's name.

      public Company addRelation(Profile profile, Relationship relationship)
      Adds (or replaces) a direct relationship to another profile.

      Note: the symmetric edge on profile's side is not added automatically; use Network.addRelation(gov.Lab3.Profile, gov.Lab3.Profile, gov.Lab3.Relationship) to create both directions.
